in_marathi.name: Jamna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jamna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jamna is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess of prosperity and wealth, Yama. She is known for bringing abundance and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Yama is the god of death and the ruler of the underworld, but his wife, Yamuna, embodies the nurturing and prosperous aspects of the deity.
